requirements.title: Styling Agent Response Quality
requirements.definition: Improve the Styling Agent's prompting and returned results independently of its mood-board, shopping-link, and selfie capabilities.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general Styling Agent prompt and result quality; mood-board generation, retrieval coverage, shopping links, and selfie styling have separate acceptance behaviors.

requirements.title: AI Fashion Mood Board Generation
requirements.definition: Allow users to prompt the Styling Agent to generate complete fashion mood boards and return them through the existing platform UI.
requirements.boundary_note: Backend prompting, response formatting, and UI presentation are coupled parts of one generated mood-board flow.

requirements.title: Expanded Fashion Source Retrieval
requirements.definition: Expand the agent's web retrieval so it returns content from a broader set of relevant fashion sources.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source breadth and retrieved fashion content; presentation and quality of actionable shopping links are independently testable.

requirements.title: Improved Shopping Link Results
requirements.definition: Improve the shopping links returned by the Styling Agent so users receive useful commerce destinations with its results.
requirements.boundary_note: Shopping-link usefulness can be changed or fail independently of the number and quality of general fashion sources retrieved.

requirements.title: Selfie Styling Feasibility Evaluation
requirements.definition: Prompt the current image model from the backend using a user's selfie, generate fashion-photo results, and provide those results for a quality decision before committing to the full feature.
requirements.boundary_note: The currently established deliverable is a concrete backend feasibility evaluation and result handoff; full production implementation remains conditional on image quality.

requirements.title: Avelin AI Provider Constraint
requirements.definition: Use the existing Avelin AI integration for platform AI capabilities and avoid introducing OpenAI because of cost.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a client-confirmed cross-cutting provider constraint rather than an attribute owned only by the mood-board feature.

requirements.title: Per-Account AI Usage Tracking
requirements.definition: Record AI usage for each account and call, including the user, agent, prompt type, and reported token usage.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers capture of usage records; consumption estimation, credit accounting, tier rules, and payment processing can evolve independently.

requirements.title: AI Consumption and Cost Ledger
requirements.definition: Maintain a backend ledger that estimates Avelin AI consumption and cost per account and prompt type to support pricing decisions.
requirements.boundary_note: Ledger calculations consume tracked usage but are independently testable from whether raw usage records are captured correctly.

requirements.title: Credit-Based Usage System
requirements.definition: Convert measured AI activity into account credits that can be consumed and limited as users interact with AI agents.
requirements.boundary_note: Credit accounting is distinct from collecting usage telemetry and from defining subscription-tier prices and limits.

requirements.title: Subscription Tiers and Usage Limits
requirements.definition: Define multiple monetization tiers with different AI usage or prompt limits based on measured consumption.
requirements.boundary_note: Tier count, pricing, and per-tier prompt or usage limits are parameters of one subscription-plan mechanism; Stripe payment execution remains separate.

requirements.title: Stripe Subscription Payments
requirements.definition: Integrate Stripe payment APIs to collect payments for the platform's subscription plans after usage-based tier design is prepared.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers payment-provider integration; usage metering, credits, and subscription entitlement rules have independent data and failure paths.

requirements.title: Google Analytics 4 Integration
requirements.definition: Instrument the platform with Google Analytics 4 for product and website activity tracking.
requirements.boundary_note: GA4 has its own integration and verification path and is separate from Clarity and affiliate-attribution tooling.

requirements.title: Microsoft Clarity Integration
requirements.definition: Instrument the platform with Microsoft Clarity for user-experience behavior tracking.
requirements.boundary_note: Clarity can be configured and verified independently of GA4 and campaign-attribution integrations.

requirements.title: Affiliate and Campaign Attribution Analytics
requirements.definition: Integrate two or three additional analytics or attribution tools for affiliate marketing and campaign tracking.
requirements.boundary_note: The unnamed additional tools form one attribution mechanism for now; they should be split later only if selected tools receive independent requirements or trajectories.

requirements.title: Showroom UX Clarity
requirements.definition: Make the showroom experience more user-friendly so users and investors can quickly understand the platform's purpose.
requirements.boundary_note: The showroom is a distinct user surface from the Concierge flow and can receive independent UX changes.

requirements.title: Concierge UX Clarity
requirements.definition: Make the Concierge flow more user-friendly and easier for users and investors to understand.
requirements.boundary_note: The Concierge flow is independently changeable from the broader showroom experience and from Styling Agent feature behavior.

requirements.title: Frontend Text Edits
requirements.definition: Apply the client-provided small text changes across the platform frontend.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a bounded editing obligation whose exact copy is pending; it is separate from structural showroom and Concierge usability improvements.

requirements.title: Shopline App Store Widget
requirements.definition: Develop a Shopline App Store widget that retrieves and presents content from the existing GIA platform.
requirements.boundary_note: The widget and its GIA-content retrieval are currently one coupled product mechanism; OAuth, API, webhook, publishing, and compliance details are not yet sufficiently client-confirmed for separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Old Backend Repository Cleanup
requirements.definition: Remove obsolete backend versions from the project's repository collection when the client permits that cleanup.
requirements.boundary_note: The client identifies obsolete backend versions for deletion but immediately instructs the freelancer not to touch the repositories, creating a distinct cleanup lifecycle rather than an active implementation instruction.

requirements.title: Repository Change Isolation
requirements.definition: Leave existing repositories unchanged, work only against the target MVP repositories, and isolate development changes on separate branches.
requirements.boundary_note: This operational source-control constraint is independently required even if all requested product features are implemented correctly.

unresolved_candidates.description: The Shopline widget is established, but the missing one-pager leaves it unclear whether OAuth, product APIs, content publishing, compliance webhooks, and other widget behaviors will become independently evolving Requirements.
